 else if(type==='paralysis')shard(ctx,px,py,3,a,'#fbe778',.82);
 else if(type==='frozen'||type==='freeze')shard(ctx,px,py,5,a,'#a3e9ff',.78);
 else if(type==='poison')puff(ctx,px,py,3,'#bb61cf',.66);
 else if(type==='sleep'){ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='#d4f6ff';ctx.globalAlpha=.75;ctx.font='bold 11px system-ui';ctx.fillText('Z',px,py);ctx.restore();}
 else if(type==='confusion')ring(ctx,px,py,4,'#f5b5ea',1.5,.67);
 else if(type==='seed')leaf(ctx,px,py,4,a,.65);
}}
function contactMotion(fx,now){const t=clamp01((now-fx.at)/(fx.end-fx.at));const approach=clamp01((t-.06)/.39),returnT=clamp01((t-.57)/.39);
 const move=lerp(0,1,ease(approach))*(1-ease(returnT));
 const distance=Math.hypot(fx.toward[0]-fx.start[0],fx.toward[1]-fx.start[1])||1;
 const near=Math.max(0,distance-64);
 return {x:(fx.toward[0]-fx.start[0])/distance*near*move,y:(fx.toward[1]-fx.start[1])/distance*near*move-Math.sin(Math.PI*t)*8};
}
// Somente visuais de frente: os sprites PMD de 8 direções terão sido ajustados
// para a linha frontal no código de drawMon; sprite de costas não é mostrado.
const oldDrawMon=BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon;
BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon=function(actor,id,isEnemy,now){
 if(actor===this.player&&!isEnemy&&this.v352Contact&&now<=this.v352Contact.end){const d=contactMotion(this.v352Contact,now);actor.x+=d.x;actor.y+=d.y;try{return oldDrawMon.call(this,actor,id,isEnemy,now);}finally{actor.x-=d.x;actor.y-=d.y;}}
 return oldDrawMon.call(this,actor,id,isEnemy,now);
};
function drawFX(ctx,f,now,e){
 const t=clamp01((now-f.at)/(f.end-f.at)),fade=clamp01(Math.min(t*8,(1-t)*7,1)),col=C[f.type]||C.normal;
 const from=f.from,to=f.to,dx=to[0]-from[0],dy=to[1]-from[1],dir=Math.atan2(dy,dx),perp=[-Math.sin(dir),Math.cos(dir)];
 const progress=clamp01((t-.07)/.75),v=ease(progress),tx=lerp(from[0],to[0],v),ty=lerp(from[1],to[1],v);
 const seed=f.seed;
 if(f.kind==='hit'){
  const m=Math.min(1,t*7),grow=(1-t)*28+5;
  ring(ctx,to[0],to[1],grow,col[1],3,fade*.9,.8);

  return;
 }

  for(let j=0;j<3;j++)ring(ctx,xx,yy,14+t*37-j*8,col[j],2.5,fade*(.65-j*.12),.7);
  for(let j=0;j<9;j++){const a=j*2.399+seed,rr=6+t*38+j%4;shard(ctx,xx+Math.cos(a)*rr,yy+Math.sin(a)*rr*.7,3,a,col[j%3],fade*.9);}
  return;
 }
 if(f.kind==='contact'){
  // A animação de contato tem passos claros, nenhuma linha ligando os Pokémon.
  const hit=clamp01((t-.43)*9),pulse=Math.sin(Math.PI*hit),xx=to[0],yy=to[1];
  if(t<.5){const a=e.player;const footX=a.x+(to[0]-a.x)*Math.min(t*1.65,.7),footY=a.y+(to[1]-a.y)*Math.min(t*1.65,.7)+e.h*.05;
   for(let k=0;k<4;k++)puff(ctx,footX-13+k*8,footY+Math.sin(k+seed)*4,3.2+k%3,'#ccbca0',fade*.36);
  }
  if(t>.36&&t<.82){
   const punch=/soco|punch|mach|comet|dynamic|impacto/.test(norm(f.name));
   const kick=/chute|kick|rolling/.test(norm(f.name));
   const radius=(kick?22:punch?16:20)*pulse;
   // Hit sparks curtos em camadas, em volta do alvo.
   ring(ctx,xx,yy,8+radius,col[2],2.3,fade*.75,.8);
   for(let j=0;j<(kick?7:9);j++){const a=j*Math.PI*2/(kick?7:9)+seed*.7;
    const r=radius*(.65+j%3*.22);shard(ctx,xx+Math.cos(a)*r,yy+Math.sin(a)*r*.7,2.6+(j%3)*2.4,a,col[j%3],fade*.95);
   }
   if(kick){curve(ctx,[[xx-30,yy-4],[xx-7,yy-21],[xx+21,yy-11],[xx+28,yy+3]],'#fff9c9',4,fade,.0);}
   else if(punch){circle(ctx,xx,yy,5+8*pulse,col[2],fade*.8);}
   else {ring(ctx,xx,yy,radius+8,col[1],5,fade*.72,.65);}
  }

 }
 if(f.kind==='razor'||f.kind==='leaves'){
  // Sete lâminas de folhas com orientação, rotação, nervura e separação.
  const count=f.kind==='razor'?9:7;
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const delay=i*.052,tt=clamp01((t-delay)/.73),q=ease(tt);
   const spread=(i-(count-1)/2),wave=Math.sin(q*9+i*1.7+seed)*10;
   const x=lerp(from[0],to[0],q)+perp[0]*(spread*7.2+wave)*(Math.sin(Math.PI*q)*.7+.18);
   const y=lerp(from[1],to[1],q)+perp[1]*(spread*7.2+wave)*(Math.sin(Math.PI*q)*.7+.18);
   leaf(ctx,x,y,7+(i%3)*1.8,dir+Math.sin(q*19+i)*.9,fade*(tt<.96?1:(1-tt)*15),i%2===0);
  }
  if(t>.49)for(let i=0;i<10;i++){const a=i*2.399+seed,d=Math.max(0,t-.49)*110;leaf(ctx,to[0]+Math.cos(a)*d*.4,to[1]+Math.sin(a)*d*.35,3.3,a+t*9,(1-t)*1.4);}
  return;
 }
 if(f.kind==='vine'){
  const points=[];for(let i=0;i<=18;i++){const q=i/18*v,rr=Math.sin(q*14+seed+now*.015)*Math.sin(Math.PI*q)*12;points.push([from[0]+dx*q+perp[0]*rr,from[1]+dy*q+perp[1]*rr]);}
  curve(ctx,points,'#125d3d',10,fade);curve(ctx,points,'#70d26a',6,fade);curve(ctx,points,'#d4fc9c',2,fade);
  for(let i=3;i<points.length;i+=5)leaf(ctx,points[i][0],points[i][1],6,dir+i*.5,fade);
  return;
 }
 if(f.kind==='quaking'||f.kind==='ground'){
  const reach=34+140*ease(t),xx=to[0],yy=to[1]+e.h*.095;
  for(let j=0;j<6;j++){const a=j*Math.PI/3+seed,pts=[[xx,yy]];
   for(let k=1;k<=4;k++){const rr=reach*k/4;pts.push([xx+Math.cos(a)*rr+Math.sin(k*j+seed)*6,yy+Math.sin(a)*rr*.45+Math.cos(k+j)*5]);}
   curve(ctx,pts,j%2?'#3c2e24':'#dfbc80',j%2?3:2,fade*.8);
  }
  for(let j=0;j<13;j++){const a=j*2.4+seed,rr=(j%5+3)*8+t*38;puff(ctx,xx+Math.cos(a)*rr,yy+Math.sin(a)*rr*.37,4+(j%4),'#bea480',fade*.35);}
  return;
 }
 if(f.kind==='rockfall'||f.kind==='rock'){
  for(let j=0;j<11;j++){const a=j*2.399+seed;
   const x=to[0]+Math.cos(a)*(15+j%4*10),y=to[1]-115+Math.sin(a)*35+150*ease(clamp01(t-j*.018));
   diamond(ctx,x,y,5+(j%3)*3,a+t*9,fade,col[j%3]);
  }
  return;
 }
 if(f.kind==='fire'||f.kind==='dragon'){
  for(let j=0;j<24;j++){const q=clamp01(v-(j/24)*.29),xx=from[0]+dx*q+perp[0]*Math.sin(j*1.7+seed+t*29)*11,yy=from[1]+dy*q+perp[1]*Math.cos(j*.9+seed+t*29)*9;

 if(f.kind==='water'){

  }

 }
 if(f.kind==='ice'){
  for(let i=0;i<13;i++){const q=clamp01(v-i*.03),x=from[0]+dx*q+perp[0]*Math.sin(i+seed+t*12)*10,y=from[1]+dy*q+perp[1]*Math.cos(i+seed+t*12)*8;

 }

   const points=[];for(let i=0;i<=12;i++){const q=i/12*v,rr=Math.sin(q*22+t*42+j*2)*Math.sin(Math.PI*q)*(4+j*1.4);points.push([from[0]+dx*q+perp[0]*rr,from[1]+dy*q+perp[1]*rr]);}

const oldDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){

 this.v351Effects=[];this.v347Sprites=[];this.v346Attacks=(this.v346Attacks||[]).filter(x=>x.kind==='bolt'||x.kind==='thunder');
 this.v343Fx=[];this.v343Named=[];this.v344Fx=[];
 try{oldDraw.call(this,now);}finally{
  this.v351Effects=[];this.v347Sprites=[];this.v346Attacks=hold.v346Attacks;
  this.v343Fx=hold.v343Fx;this.v343Named=hold.v343Named;this.v344Fx=hold.v344Fx;
 }
 if(!battle?.active||!this.ctx)return;
 const ctx=this.ctx,fx=this.v352FX||[],low=this.fps>0&&this.fps<27;
 for(const f of fx.slice(low?-9:-20))if(now>=f.at&&now<f.end){ctx.save();drawFX(ctx,f,now,this);ctx.restore();}
 // Camada de auras contínuas, independente de sprites estáticos.
 if(this.v25?.stats){for(const side of ['player','enemy']){
  const actor=this[side],conditions=this.v25.stats[side]?.conditions||[];
  for(const st of conditions.slice(0,3))statusAura(ctx,st,actor.x,actor.y,this.h,now);
 }}
};
